replay.detectors.commLossExplanation: No gauge reported anything from {from} to {to} ({seconds} s). That can mean the ignition was turned off, the adapter lost its link, or the car stopped answering. A gap alone doesn't say which, and it is not a stall.
replay.detectors.loopChangeExplanation: Changed from "{previous}" to "{status}". Open loop is normal while the engine warms up and when coasting or under heavy load; closed loop is normal at steady cruise.
replay.detectors.loopFaultExplanation: The fuel system status read "{status}" for {seconds} s. The car's own status is worth checking with a code scan.
replay.detectors.loopFaultTitle: Fuel system reported a fault state
replay.detectors.loopFlappingExplanation: The fuel system changed between open and closed loop {count} or more times within a minute. Mixed driving (coasting, then accelerating) can do this. If it happens at a steady speed, it's worth a closer look.
replay.detectors.rpmExplanation: RPM moved between about {low} and {high} while the reported speed stayed near {speedRange}. This may be a gear shift or torque-converter change, a change in road load, or abnormal engine behavior. Review the data around {time} before drawing a conclusion.
replay.detectors.rpmTitle: RPM changed a lot at a steady speed
replay.detectors.stallExplanation: RPM dropped from about {rpm} to 0 and stayed there for {seconds} s while other gauges kept answering{movingText}. That fits an engine that stopped with the ignition on, but a deliberate shut-off, a start-stop system, or a bad RPM reading can look the same.
replay.detectors.stallMoving: , with the car still reading {speed} (some hybrids and start-stop cars do this normally)
replay.events.noneFound: Nothing unusual found. That is not a clean bill of health: WOBD only checks a few patterns.
replay.events.onlyRoutine: Only routine events were found{count}. Tick the box above to see them.
replay.html.compactNotes: · one compact file with your notes
replay.html.description: Replay a WOBD live data recording with gauges and graphs. Your file stays in your browser.
replay.html.dropFile: Or drop a CSV or .wobd file anywhere on this page. Your file is read right here in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
replay.html.gauges: Gauges at this point in the drive
replay.html.graphHint: · hover to read a value, click to jump there
replay.html.heading: Replay a Drive
replay.html.includeCsv: Include the original CSV file inside (recommended)
replay.html.label: Label
replay.html.lede: Watch a WOBD live data recording play back on the same gauges, with graphs that build up as it goes.
replay.html.makeRecording: Make one with Start Recording on WOBD's Live data tab.
replay.html.noNotesYet: No notes yet. Pause where something happened, then add one.
replay.html.notesSubtitle: · your own marks on this drive. The recording itself is never changed.
replay.html.patternDescription: These are patterns worth a look, not diagnoses. WOBD checks the recording against fixed, conservative rules and can be wrong. Dismissing one hides it here but keeps the data.
replay.html.patternsSubtitle: · found automatically, separate from your notes
replay.html.reportDescription: A multi-page report of this drive: summary numbers, graphs, every detected pattern, and the notes you tick under Notes. It never includes the VIN or any location. Nothing is uploaded.
replay.html.showRoutine: Also show routine events (normal open/closed loop changes)
replay.html.title: Replay a Drive · WOBD
replay.html.vehicleOptional: Vehicle (optional, printed as you type it)
replay.html.wobdDescription: A .wobd file is a smaller, checked copy of this recording that can carry your notes. Your CSV is never changed or deleted.

replay.quality.assumedLocal: The timestamps have no time zone, so they are shown as local time as recorded.
replay.quality.clockJumps: where the clock jumped or drifted from elapsed time (possible clock change)
replay.quality.duplicateRows: repeated at the same moment (all kept)
replay.quality.elapsedOnly: No usable timestamps: only elapsed time is shown, and no date or clock time is guessed.
replay.quality.everyRow: Every row had a readable timestamp, in order.
replay.quality.malformedTimestamps: with a timestamp that couldn't be read (their elapsed time is still used)
replay.quality.missingTimestamps: with no timestamp (their elapsed time is still used)

replay.quality.summaryClean: Recording quality · no timestamp problems found
replay.report.allPatternsListed: Every pattern WOBD found is listed, including routine ones and ones marked as false alarms.
replay.report.averageMethod: Samples are readings received, not separate events. The average is of readings, so gauges WOBD asked for more often count for more.
replay.report.detailLimit: Detail sections are shown for the first {shown} of {total} patterns. The rest are in the table above; use Replay to inspect them.
replay.report.disclaimer: This report is not a professional diagnosis. It lists what WOBD read from the car and a few patterns that may deserve a second look. Always confirm a problem before replacing parts.
replay.report.footer: WOBD session report{vehicle} · General information, not a professional diagnosis.
replay.report.gapCount_one: {formattedCount} gap, {gapTime} with no readings; {connectedTime} with readings
replay.report.gapCount_other: {formattedCount} gaps, {gapTime} with no readings; {connectedTime} with readings
replay.report.gaps: Gaps with no readings at all
replay.report.graphExplanation: Lines break wherever a gauge had no readings, and grey bands mark stretches when nothing answered at all. Orange bands are detected patterns; dashed red lines are your notes. Circles mark the highest and lowest points.
replay.report.methodDetectors: Pattern rules (detector set v{version}): a reading older than {fresh} s is ignored when compared; RPM swing of {rpmSwing} rpm within {rpmWindow} s at a steady speed above {speedMin} {speedUnit}; a new fuel-loop state must hold {loopDwell} s; a stall needs RPM above {stallRpm} just before dropping to 0 for {stallHold} s while other gauges still answer.
replay.report.methodExclusions: Diagnostic trouble codes, freeze-frame data and GPS location are not part of a recording, so they are not in this report.
replay.report.methodGap: A connection gap is a stretch longer than {seconds} s with no reading from any gauge. A gap alone never counts as a stall or a fault.
replay.report.methodGraphs: The recording was not changed. Graphs are simplified to fit the page but keep each highest and lowest point.
replay.report.methodSampling: Readings are taken one after another, not at the same instant, so two gauges at the same time are close but not simultaneous.
replay.report.notesLeftOut_one: {formattedCount} note was left out of this report.
replay.report.notesLeftOut_other: {formattedCount} notes were left out of this report.
replay.report.quietGauges: Some gauges stopped answering for a while while others kept going, so their graph lines break: {labels}.
replay.report.statesNotSummarized: Not summarized because they are states, not numbers: {labels}.
replay.report.subtitle: Diagnostic session report
replay.report.timestampProblems: Timestamp problems in the file (rows were kept unchanged): {problems}.
replay.report.vehicleNotEntered: Not entered (WOBD recordings do not store the vehicle)
